items.h: Do the Broncos have a reliable No. 1 running back? Sorting Denver's backfield
items.s: The Broncos' running game has been stuck in neutral, as J.K. Dobbins, RJ Harvey and Tyler Badie have struggled in the early going.

items.h: Tyler Badie emerging for struggling Broncos rushing attack?
items.s: Badie was expected to be on the practice squad, but his big-play ability is earning him more playing time in Denver.

items.h: Fantasy football free agent pickups Week 4: Covering for injured quarterbacks
items.s: Need a fill-in for an injured QB like Justin Herbert, Tua Tagovailoa or Jordan Love? Eric Moody provides his waiver wire suggestions for Week 4.

items.h: Badie was waived by the Broncos on Tuesday, Parker Gabriel of the Denver Post reports.
items.s: Badie has been a regular on Denver's practice squad each of the last two seasons and signed a reserve/future contract with the team in January. Now, he'll likely have to find another practice squad opportunity,
